description: A relay last applied generation 44, but its app peer's current generation is 42 (the app peer stays stateless about relay history — e.g. it was restored from an older backup). The relay pulls with since_generation 44 — a generation GREATER than the app peer's current one. REL-051: this MUST draw the full state.snapshot (sections included), never a state.unchanged asserting agreement that does not exist. The divergence then surfaces at the relay's own REL-052 gate, which refuses the regressed generation 42 outright — last-applied stays {44} — and the relay acknowledges with a state.ack that reports error rather than an advanced applied_generation, carrying the correlation id of the state.pull exchange that delivered the refused snapshot (REL-054).
